items.source: Apply the given CorsConfiguration to the one being configured via CorsConfiguration.combine(CorsConfiguration) which in turn has been initialized with CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues().
items.translation: 将给定的 `CorsConfiguration` 应用于通过 CorsConfiguration.combine(CorsConfiguration) 配置的对象，该对象已通过 CorsConfiguration.applyPermitDefaultValues() 初始化。

items.source: By default, all origins are allowed, but if allowedOriginPatterns is also set, then that takes precedence.
items.translation: 默认情况下，允许所有源，但如果同时设置了`allowedOriginPatterns`，则以后者为准。

items.source: Please, see CorsConfiguration.setAllowedMethods(List) for details.
items.translation: 请参见CorsConfiguration.setAllowedMethods(List)以获取详细信息。

items.source: Please, see CorsConfiguration.setAllowedHeaders(List) for details.
items.translation: 请参见CorsConfiguration.setAllowedHeaders(List)以获取详细信息。

items.source: Please, see CorsConfiguration.setExposedHeaders(List) for details.
items.translation: 请参见CorsConfiguration.setExposedHeaders(List)以获取详细信息。

items.source: Please, see CorsConfiguration.setAllowPrivateNetwork(Boolean) for details.
items.translation: 请参见CorsConfiguration.setAllowPrivateNetwork(Boolean)以获取详细信息。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: By default all headers are allowed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，允许所有标头。

items.source: By default this is set to 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
items.translation: 默认情况下，该值设置为 1800 秒（30 分钟）。

items.source: Assists with the creation of a CorsConfiguration instance for a given URL path pattern.
items.translation: 协助为给定的 URL 路径模式创建CorsConfiguration实例。

items.source: Alternative to allowedOrigins(String...) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 作为 `allowedOrigins(String...)` 的替代方案，支持更灵活的浏览器跨域请求源指定模式。

items.source: other - the configuration to apply
items.translation: other - 要应用的配置

items.source: NOTE: Be aware that this option establishes a high level of trust with the configured domains and also increases the surface attack of the web application by exposing sensitive user-specific information such as cookies and CSRF tokens.
items.translation: 注意： 请注意，此选项会与配置的域建立高度信任关系，同时也会增加 Web 应用程序的攻击面，因为它会暴露敏感的用户特定信息（如 Cookie 和 CSRF 令牌）。

items.source: By default this is not set in which case the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header is also not set and credentials are therefore not allowed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置，此时`Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` 响应头也未设置，因此不允许使用凭据。

items.source: By default this is not set (i.e. private network access is not supported).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此选项未设置（即不支持私有网络访问）。

items.source: Set the HTTP methods to allow, for example, "GET", "POST", etc.
items.translation: 设置允许使用的 HTTP 方法，例如 `"GET"`、`"POST"` 等。

items.source:
Whether the browser should send credentials, such as cookies along with
cross domain requests, to the annotated endpoint.
items.translation: 浏览器是否应将凭证（例如 Cookie）连同跨域请求一起发送到已注解的端点。

items.source:
Set the list of headers that a pre-flight request can list as allowed
for use during an actual request.
items.translation: 设置预检请求可以列出的、在正式请求期间允许使用的标头列表。

items.source: Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 设置允许浏览器发起跨域请求的源。

items.source: Whether private network access is supported.
items.translation: 是否支持私有网络访问。

items.source:
Set the list of response headers that an actual response might have and
can be exposed.
items.translation: 设置实际响应可能具有且可以暴露的响应头列表。

items.source:
Configure how long in seconds the response from a pre-flight request
can be cached by clients.
items.translation: 配置客户端可以缓存预检请求响应的时长（以秒为单位）。

items.source: Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev
items.translation: Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev
